title: RRF -> rerank -> MMR unified retrieval profile
implemented: reciprocal_rank_fusion: RRF over 1-based rank positions with score = sum(1/(k+rank)); raw scores from different vector spaces are never added; dedup by (uri, chunk_id)
RRF constant default 60 (configurable); deterministic ordering: fused score desc, first-seen order, uri, chunk_id; path iteration sorted by name so insertion order cannot affect output
normalize_scores: min-max into [0,1]; degenerate/all-equal/non-finite input collapses to 1.0

mmr_select: MMR at the FINAL selection stage; relevance (min-max normalized) and redundancy both in [0,1]; default lambda=0.7; lambda=1 pure relevance, lambda=0 pure diversity; ties follow deterministic input order
jaccard_similarity / token_set: cross-space redundancy via unified text/summary token/Jaccard, reusing openviking.indexing.lexical.tokenize (version-locked); explicitly NOT cross-space vector math

apply_rerank: rerank model count validation (wrong count rejected, never zipped positionally); on exception/None/count-mismatch -> permissive profile keeps fused order and marks degraded=true; strict_rerank profile raises RerankRequiredError; no rerank client configured is NOT a degradation
expand_parents: greedy parent-context expansion in rank order within a token budget; budget<=0 disables
aggregate_by_uri: aggregate by original source_uri while keeping every matches[] chunk (chunk_id/parent_chunk_id/text/parent_text/score/score_components); namespace_id preserved
run_fusion: single pure orchestration point (recall budget -> RRF -> rerank -> MMR -> parent expansion -> URI aggregation) with effective config + degraded flag recorded in trace
FusionProfile/profile_for: defaults recall 100, fused 100, rerank 50, MMR top 10, rrf_k 60, lambda 0.7; validation of name/limits/lambda; as_trace() for trace recording

hierarchical_retriever.py: new RetrieverMode.HYBRID and _retrieve_hybrid; leaf/global L2 recall always executed independent of navigation/rerank/lexical/ACL toggles; lexical recall path is an injected callable (no second user-facing search API); pipeline run via asyncio.to_thread; _build_fusion_reranker adapts RerankClient to the pure rerank callable; trace written via telemetry.set('hybrid.*'); quick/thinking paths untouched

regression_result.note: No new failures. Pre-existing tests/retrieve/test_hierarchical_retriever_rerank.py failures reported in the task brief did NOT reproduce in this working tree; the whole tests/retrieve/ suite passed (92 passed).
